title: Fierce Abstract Tiger Roaring with Flames
description: The image showcases a stylized, abstract representation of a tiger in a dynamic pose, with its mouth wide open as if roaring. The tiger's fur is depicted with a mix of geometric shapes and lines, using a vibrant color palette that includes shades of orange, black, white, and hints of blue and red. Flames are illustrated behind the tiger, adding to the intensity of the scene. The composition is centered on the tiger's face and upper body, with the flames extending towards the right side of the image. The artwork has a modern, graphic quality suitable for various merchandise applications.
